g.text: Hardware Streaming Dataflow: 3D Graphics, 2D Blit, Systolic Matrix Acceleration, and Display Scanout
1. 3D Graphics Pipeline (Geometry → Setup & Raster → Fragment & Texture → Tile Blend & Cache Writeback)
• 4-Bank Interleaved L1 Texture Cache (1-cyc quad texel fetch)
2. 2D Blitter & Fast Memory Copy Pipeline (Fill / Copy / Format Convert / MSAA 4x Resolve)
• 1 KiB Dual Ping-Pong DMA Buffers (Sustained 2.0+ GB/s Streaming Throughput)
• 1-Cycle Parallel MSAA 4x Resolve (4-Sample Downsample Box Average without Stall)
• Fast Color Fill, Alpha-Over Blending, and Linear ↔ Tiled Texture Layout Transposition
3. Systolic Matrix Multiplication & LLM Accelerator Pipeline (Scalable to 100 TOPS)
4. Display Controller (DC) Scanout & Multi-Level Watermark Preemption Path (Tear-Free 1080p@60Hz)
